description: This file defines functions, types, and constants for Git revision parsing routines in the libgit2 library.

methods.name: git_revparse_single
methods.description: Finds a single object specified by a revision string in a repository.

methods.name: git_revparse_ext
methods.description: Finds a single object and an intermediate reference by a revision string.

methods.name: git_revparse
methods.description: Parses a revision string for 'from', 'to', and intent, returning a git_revspec.
